grounding.states: lowest insured (high-ratio, under 20% down) 5-year fixed rate is 4.34%, Toronto area, as of Oct 12, 2026
grounding.from: Ratehub lists the best high-ratio (insured) 5-year fixed rate in Canada at 4.34%. Wowa gives the same 4.34% as the lowest insured 5-year fixed rate.

grounding.states: rates have been climbing in October 2026, after big banks raised fixed rates since early September
grounding.from: Rates are climbing in October 2026, after all six of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September.

value.answer: Around Toronto, the lowest insured 5-year fixed (under 20% down) is 4.34% right now. Uninsured rates are higher, but the sources I found don't agree on the lowest uninsured number, so I can't give you one. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September. Are you putting down under 20%, or 20% or more?
